exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to 1,930 posts of Nursing Officer in ESIC is conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) via a pen-and-paper offline Recruitment Test (RT) followed by document verification. The RT is of 2 hours duration consisting of multiple-choice questions carrying equal marks. The test carries a total of 100 marks (or scaled to 300) with negative marking of one-third (0.33) marks for each wrong answer. There is no interview for this Group B non-gazetted post; final selection is based 100% on marks obtained in the Recruitment Test subject to qualifying medical and document standards.

financial_package.note: ESIC Nursing Officers are appointed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900). In addition to standard Central Government allowances (DA, HRA, Transport Allowance), nursing personnel are entitled to specialized statutory health sector allowances including Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/month) and Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/month).
financial_package.pay_source_label: UPSC Advt. No. 52/2024: Pay Scale Level 7 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC (₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 7 Entry Basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + HRA (₹13,470 for Class X metro, ₹8,980 for Class Y) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) + Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/mo) + Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/mo). Gross in Class X metro is ~₹99,100; net in-hand is ~₹84,000–₹86,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and statutory taxes.
official_perks: Nursing Allowance of ₹7,200 per month as sanctioned under 7th Central Pay Commission recommendations
Uniform Allowance of ₹1,800 per month (₹21,600 per annum) for hospital clinical duties
Comprehensive medical care for self and dependent family members through ESIC dispensaries and model hospitals
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Central Government Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (₹2,250/child/month)
Night Weightage Allowance and special duty allowances for clinical shifts in intensive care units
